svg.title: TIN revenue streams: TCA, PSA, and MCA

text.tspan: Rakurai Transaction Inclusion Network (TIN) Revenue Streams
There are three separate revenue streams, each with a dedicated account per service, per validator. Rakurai charges a commission percentage and remaining revenue is claimed to the corresponding
validator identity account.
TCA — Tips Collection Account (Stream 1)
· One TCA per service, per validator
· Traders and landing services tip into a tip account. The scheduler uses those tips to prioritize their transactions.
· Rakurai Tip Account (Default & Recommended)
· Trader / landing service tips any of Rakurai’s eight tip accounts
· Minimum Recommended tip: 0.001 SOL
· Scheduler uses that tip to prioritize the transaction
· Each leader turn: tip accounts are emptied
· Rakurai commission is deducted on every leader turn
· Remaining amount accumulated in validator's TCA
· Next epoch → claimed to the validator identity account
· Partner Tip Account (Interim Support)
· You register your own tip account with Rakurai
· 60% of the total tip is used for virtual priority
· Tips land in your account — Rakurai cannot drain them
· Each leader turn: validator tracks and records 60% of the total tip in TCA as an amount owed
· no SOL moves yet
· Next epoch → you transfer the owed SOL into the TCA
· Claimed to the validator identity account
If you do not settle the owed tips within 2 epochs, that partner tip account will no longer be used for prioritization.
PSA — P2C Subscription Account (Stream 2)
· One PSA per service, per validator
· Prepaid access fee to use the post-pack confirmations (Step-1 for Backrun)
A prepaid subscription fee deducted from PSA based on txn Updates ($50 / 1M updates). Paying this fee
gives you access to post-pack confirmation (P2C) updates. Backrun profits are shared separately
through the MCA.
· Rakurai creates a PSA (one PSA per service, per validator)
· 60-70% of P2C subscription revenue shared through TIN²,³
· Expected baseline: $50 / 1M txn updates¹
· PSA is funded with prepaid SOL
· any wallet can fund the account
· Service receives post-pack confirmations from the validator
· Epoch ends → fee deducted from PSA
· amount based on txn updates ($50 / 1M updates)
· Next epoch → fee claimed to the validator identity account
If you do not settle the subscription fee within 2 epochs, the P2C stream will stop.
MCA — MevShare Collection Account (Stream 3)
· One MCA per service, per validator
· Share backrun profit from post-pack confirmations (Step-2 for Backrun)
After paying the PSA subscription fee, you can access pre-execution (P2C) transactions streamed from
the point of no return and use them for backrun. Backrun bundles using P2C source transactions get a
20% virtual priority boost. The resulting profit is shared with the validator through the MCA.
· Rakurai creates a MCA (one MCA per service, per validator)
· 60-70% of backrun / MEV revenue shared through TIN³
· Expected baseline: 60-70 SOL / month / 1M SOL stake
· During the epoch: you trade as usual
· nothing is taken automatically — profit stays with you
· Backrun RevShare reporting by service
· Pay-as-you-go throughout the epoch or once at epoch end
· Backrun RevShare transferred to MCA
· Pay-as-you-go or as one accumulated transfer at epoch end
· Next epoch → RevShare claimed to the validator identity account
If you do not report and settle backrun revenue within 2 epochs, you will stop receiving P2C stream.
Where the money ends up
TCA-Tips
PSA-Fee
MCA-Revshare
Claim to validator identity account
after Rakurai’s commission
Optional: convert to Block Reward using high-priority transactions during
the leader turn⁴
¹ Dollar equivalent amount in SOL.
² If you are selling P2C to searchers, you must share 60-70% of that subscription revenue.
³ You should have a Revenue Share Management System (RSMS) / revenue recognition / attribution system to provide an audit upon request from Rakurai or the validator.

⁴ Revenue Double-Counting: To prevent revenue from being counted twice when converted to Block Rewards, tools and indexers should verify the block_reward_conversion_enabled flag in the respective TCA, PSA, and MCA accounts.
Prices, revenue percentages, and expected baselines shown above are expected to change.
